sentences.translation: Once upon a time, there lived a man, with a big hump on his right cheek.
One day, the old man went all the way to the mountains.
But it began to rain.
The old man fled into the old hall in the mountains.
We will not stop raining even at night.
The old man was bent over there.
At night, he awoke with a loud noise.
Looking out of the hall, many demons were swirling in a lively manner, to the tune of the flute and the fiddle.
"This is interesting!"
The grandfather, who had been swept away by the fear, went out and imitated the demons and began to go back.
The ogres were snug because the grandfather's dance was so good.
"Oh, come back, old man, and leave the cheeks on the side of it, and on the sign that it will come again."
said the ogre.
and the demons took off the grandfather's cheeks.
The old man, who had been ripped off for many years, returned home with great pleasure.
I heard this, and my grandfather was there.
This grandfather had a big hump on his left cheek.
"I will go to the mountains and get a hump."
The old man went to the temple.
At night the demons came out again and began to return.
and the old man went out and tried to frighten him.
But the old man's dance was so shy that it was not interesting at all.
The demons looked bored and said,
"Your dance is not interesting at all, so I'll take you back to the hump."
and the demons put another hump on the left cheek of the grandpa.
The old man, who had come to him, had two humpies, and went home crying.
It's over.
